newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan asset-backed shares up on speculative buy.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan asset-backed shares up on speculative buy.

text.p: Asset-backed shares in Taiwan climbed strongly at mid-morning on Friday on speculative buying, brokers said.
With 70 minutes left, Tung Ho Spinning rose T$1.1 or 4.42 percent to T$26 and Ta Jung Transport surged T$1.7 or 3.41 percent to T$51.5.
"In a market that is entering a consolidation, investors tend to buy more speculative issues like asset-backed shares," said National Securities analyst Eric Liu.

Asset-backed shares include those with abundant assets of land or closed plants that may be converted into more valuable commercial districts or could be purchased by the government for infrastructure projects.
"This gives investors imagination room for the possible future benefits these asset-backed shares may enjoy," Liu said.
